notes:
Summary: Stonebridge Infra & AI platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated for customer-facing chat/ranking workloads. Primary goal: predictable latency and throughput with contractual uptime and credits.

Current posture: procurement stage. Security & legal heavy. Preference for private/VPC deployment with optional on-prem for regulated subteams. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching & quantization to reduce unit costs.

SLA / contract specifics discussed: 
- Requested uptime: 99.95% (customer asks for 99.99% for top-tier critical endpoints; Redwood proposed 99.95% for Dedicated).
- Credit schedule proposed by AE: 
  * <99.95% and >=99.90%: 10% monthly credit on Dedicated fees
  * <99.90% and >=99.50%: 25% credit
  * <99.50%: 50% credit + option to terminate after 60 days if unresolved
- Maintenance window: monthly 02:00-05:00 UTC preferred; Stonebridge requests at most 2 hours per month and advance 7-day notice for planned maintenance impacting the dedicated pool.
- Support SLA: P1 response 30-60 min (phone + Slack), P2 response 4 hours, P3 response 24 hours. Escalation path to SE + engineering on P1.

Throughput & latency targets discussed: 
- Baseline workload: external chat service, 120 concurrent sessions, average 512 tokens/request, peak 250 reqs/s.
- Target throughput: sustain 200 reqs/s steady-state with 95th pct token echo; burst to 400 reqs/s for 10m windows.
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 70 ms, p95 < 180 ms, tail p99 < 450 ms for 512-token responses.
- Acceptance test: 72-hour soak at 80% sustained load + three 10-minute spike tests to burst levels. Must show no more than 0.5% error rate and meet p95 latency SLO.

Reserved GPU planning: 
- Initial sizing request from Redwood SE: 6 x H100-80GB equiv reserved nodes (or 8 x A100-80GB equiv) to meet throughput/latency with margin.
- Stonebridge asks for clear uplift path: ability to add 25% capacity within 24 hours for seasonal events, plus auto-burst to hosted pool as fallback.
- Cost sensitivity: targeting 20-30% lower unit cost vs their current cloud-hosted endpoints. Redwood Optimize to provide batching + kv-cache config.

Security & compliance notes: 
- Must support EU data residency for EU customers and separation of EU workload (requesting per-region dedicated nodes).
- KMS integration mandatory, SOC2 attestation required before contract execution.
- Audit logging retention: 12 months required, with option to extend.

Procurement / legal: 
- Legal redlines: liability cap to be discussed (Stonebridge wants 2x ARR; Redwood proposes standard 6 months fees cap).
- Data residency clause: Stonebridge insists on explicit contractual residency for EU customer data.
- Insurance & indemnity: exec teams to review.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2024-10-18: Intro call (AE Sofia) — product overview, initial sizing ask. Fireflies: ff_20241018_x12nef.
- 2024-11-05: Tech deep-dive (SE Ethan) — benchmarking expectations, latency SLOs confirmed.
- 2024-11-18: Legal + Security intro (Sofia + Priya) — delivered security pack, SOC2. Fireflies: ff_20241118_k7h2zq.
- 2024-11-29: SLA negotiation session (AE, SE, Stonebridge legal) — agreed to Redwood draft SLA v3; Stonebridge requested credit schedule and stricter maintenance windows. Fireflies: ff_20241129_b9m1st.
- 2024-12-02: Procurement sent initial PO draft; legal sent redlines (thread-legal-sla-20241202).
- 2024-12-05: SE provided revised capacity estimate and cost model; planning soak test.

Next steps (short):
- Internal Redwood: circulate final SLA with AE + SE + Legal comments by 2024-12-12.
- Schedule 72h soak test on reserved pool week of 2024-12-16 (confirm windows & test plan).
- Stonebridge to provide sample production trace data for workload characterization by 2024-12-10.
- Procurement: finalize budget approval and PO terms (target sign by 2025-01).

Quotable from CTO call: "We can tolerate brief planned maintenance but need contractual limits on frequency and credits if availability drops below promised SLOs. Also need a concrete escalation path for P1 incidents."

Stakes: High — mission-critical customer-facing features (fraud alerts + chat). Win would solidify an enterprise Dedicated reference for FS vertical.
